name: tironirifa-backend
description: TironiRifa - backend: API HTTP, worker e banco. Fonte versionada dos contratos.

scripts.prepare:internal: npm run build -w @campaigns/shared && npm run build -w @campaigns/db
scripts.typecheck: npm run prepare:internal && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:tests
scripts.dev:api: npm run prepare:internal && npm run dev -w @campaigns/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run prepare:internal && npm run dev -w @campaigns/worker
